title: Understanding Model Bias
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it affects the model's ability to capture the underlying data patterns. Consider whether the model might become less flexible and how that could impact the bias.

title: Exploring Model Variance
text: Consider how removing a feature might affect the model's sensitivity to fluctuations in the training data. Does having fewer features make the model more or less stable?

title: Training Data MSE
text: Think about how the model's performance on the training data might change when a feature is removed. Does the model become simpler, and how might that affect the error on the training data?

title: Test Data MSE
text: Reflect on how the model's ability to generalize to unseen data might be impacted by removing a feature. Does the change make the model more robust or more prone to errors on new data?

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: What is a possible effect on (model bias) squared when a feature is removed from the model?
